evidence: CVE.org https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-72768 has cveMetadata.state=PUBLISHED (CNA VulnCheck) describing authenticated MCP Client SSRF that reaches internal or blocked hosts and returns responses through the workflow (CWE-918).

Vendor advisory https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/security/advisories/GHSA-vhf8-cg2h-cg3p is state=published, withdrawn_at=null, and says the MCP Client node sent a user-supplied endpoint without instance SSRF protection and without address pinning. GitHub Advisory Database GHSA-xv2r-whj9-7vqh maps CVE-2026-72768 to that vendor advisory and is also unwithdrawn.

At n8n@2.31.4 blob 653f2ad88b43bdd0f01e8340447b53619ab8f609 (McpClient.node.ts) execute() reads endpointUrl from node parameters and calls connectMcpClientForCredential. Affected shared/utils.ts blob 71d6b6f29556d212b6afe339e35fff0e766e49fe wraps transports in proxyFetch/fetchFollowingRedirects with only credential allowedDomains (assertUrlAllowed); it never calls ctx.helpers.getSecureEgressFilter or pins a validated address. execute() then returns callTool content into workflow items.

GitHub PR https://api.github.com/repos/n8n-io/n8n/pulls/21942/commits lists 47 public members under squash landing 69e092a263fc5890d783247eb2759d1419f9c7f1. The earliest member 5b3feb332f8b85a1e00319c69dffa6726b57feff (subject 'wip: MCP client') first-adds McpClient.node.ts (user-controlled mcpServerUrl), utils.ts (connectMcpClient using raw fetch for SSE and StreamableHTTPClientTransport without an instance egress filter), and listSearch.ts (connects and returns MCP tool metadata).

Later public members extend rather than first-write that sink: 24f88fe6d2f5fc3e28ca4c6f20f48e76fea2e254 moves the helper into mcp/shared/utils.ts; 574b84c8ecbe448be1c1dfd5b46a5313ef7e7561 adds execute(); 53a0e41f32ba43bde9201ff97e4cc71c7bfb2e62 only retouches shared/utils.ts ('fix: Proxy for SSE'). Squash 69e092a263fc5890d783247eb2759d1419f9c7f1 is therefore a carrier, not the atomic BIC.
